title: Send Backward (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Send Backward applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Send Backward (BtnSendBackward) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Send Backward decides its target stacking order in the host-neutral plan
scenarios.expected: The one-step backward plan keeps the first selected shape at the bottom of the selection (plan 12,1,11,2 on the working order 11,1,12,2 with selection order 12,11) and the unselected shapes keep their exact slots. The one-layer move itself is the office-automated leg (QA9-BtnSendBackward-002).

scenarios.title: Send Backward applies its planned stacking change in a real PowerPoint host
scenarios.expected: On the isolated Office host, three probe shapes are created with distinct stacking positions (bottom-to-top in creation order) and the second-bottommost probe is selected alone. Send Backward is invoked through the same production entry point the visible command uses. The selected probe must move exactly one layer backward (slot 2 of 3 -> slot 1), the two unselected probes must keep their relative order, all three probes must still exist afterwards, and no new entry may appear in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log.
